title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1549: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (3)

title.p: Chapter 1549: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (3)

section.p: Seeing that there were no objections, Moge reached out toward Mo Duona. As for the other devil survivors, he continued inspecting them carefully lest Su Yu was hidden among them.
The moment Mo Duona was brought to Moge’s side, he sent a voice transmission, “Ancestor, this has nothing to do with us. Let’s leave first.”

“Leave?” Moge frowned and replied with a voice transmission, “Su Yu must die here. He will grow into a massive disaster in the future if he’s allowed to live. Don’t forget that he’s your peer. With him around, you will be completely overshadowed. Luck itself will start favoring him over you. As a result, even your growth will slow significantly.”
Mo Duona sank into silence. He said nothing else. It was obvious his ancestor was unwilling to leave. But he was worried that something bad might happen.

The Daofuse eyes continued scanning the survivors. They didn’t even bother to hide the oppression of their auras when inspecting those from the minor races. Even Daofuses would act differently against different people.
They wouldn’t care about races without powerful experts. Meanwhile, they would only perform a light scan against those from powerful races and stay away from the seas of willpower of these people.
Just then, a slightly pale immortal Invincible exclaimed in joy, “My child is still alive!”
That attracted a bunch of gazes. That was the sole survivor. The sole immortal survivor.
Su Yu was surprised to hear that. Did he miss someone?
A Sunmoon immortal among the survivors looked around blankly. Then, fear crept in as he realized that he was the sole immortal survivor.
He looked at his father and hurriedly said, “Father, I went down and checked the first level as instructed. There was no danger. Su Yu was nowhere to be found.”

He suddenly recalled his father’s words. Yes. He had to claim that he had investigated the first level or things might get troublesome. This was the immortal contacted by the immortal Invincible previously. He had run off long before anything big happened while pretending to investigate the first level.

He ran straight to the seventh level. And before the others on the seventh level realized anything, he ran to the eighth level. There, he hid inside the residence of an immortal general until the closure of the mansion.
He had benefited significantly from that seclusion, advancing all the way to the eighth-stage Sunmoon Realm. Now that he was outside the mansion, he was greatly alarmed. Was everyone else dead?
Holy shit!
In that case, he had to insist that he had investigated the first level or the blame might fall on him. But the moment he made that claim, everyone’s expression turned odd.
Was he really at the first level?
Was he sure?
He Tu had killed his way from the first level.
How did this immortal not encounter He Tu?
This was clearly a lie!
The immortal Invincible’s face stiffened, but he recovered immediately and said, “Shut your mouth! You reached the sixth level immediately. How were you on the first level? Stop babbling nonsense!”
Nonsense? The immortal Sunmoon was stunned. What was wrong with his father? His father was the one who had told him to say that previously.

The immortal Invincible was cunning enough to maintain an indifferent expression and said, “Enough. You ran off in fear after hearing about He Tu. Sigh. Why do I have such a useless descendant? How can you run the moment you hear about He Tu? How dare you lie to cover your shameful behavior?”
He Tu?

The immortal Sunmoon was not stupid. Those words were enough to hit him with a certain realization. He seemed to have said something wrong. Was He Tu in the mansion? In that case, his lie would be too obvious. Whatever. He had survived. He only cared about that.

Was everyone else really dead? That wasn’t possible. They had five immortal kings in the mansion. He didn’t even dare to imagine it. Apart from the five immortal kings, the Invincibles of the other races were also gone.
The various Invincibles were naturally not stupid. They could easily see through the act. Thus, they all stared at the immortal Invincible coldly.
Understood.

That immortal Invincible was the first to contact a descendant inside. Everyone believed that he had sent his son to the first level, but everything was a lie. Damn him! As an immortal king, how could he be so shameless?

The lie had been exposed. At the same time, the other immortal kings were also envious and furious. All other immortals had died. Only this guy’s son had survived. That was most likely due to what he told his son during the communication.
Su Yu was surprised, but he was able to guess the truth as well.
Impressive.
One of them had actually survived.
He had no choice but to be impressed by the luck of the immortal race.

Noticing that the other Invincibles were still pressuring the humans, he inhaled deeply. This must be stopped lest they somehow discover Great Qin King. Great Qin King might have recovered considerably, but he had still lost two bodies.
With a look of grim determination, Su Yu took a step forward, moving a bit further away from Grandstar. He furiously said, “Are you really stopping me? Don’t push it! I’m only taking my people back!”

The four Invincibles were stunned. They had seen people courting death before, but they had never seen someone court death so passionately. Was this guy really trying to die? They would ignore him when he was beside Grandstar, but why was he stepping forth alone? Did he know no fear?
The immortal king beside Tian Yu asked, “Is living not good? You’re a nobody. Shut your mouth and stay out of this. We will only dirty our hands killing you.”
As Invincibles, they viewed personally killing a nobody like that as an insult.
Su Yu maintained his furious, anxious, and helpless expression as he gnashed his teeth and looked back at Grandstar. “Lord, will you really act when they attack me?”
The four Invincibles nearly laughed upon hearing that. Wasn’t he so brave just moments ago?
Why was he suddenly scared? Sure enough, a fake was a fake. There was no comparing him with Su Yu. What an amusing little clown. This was nothing but entertainment to them.
Previously, they were still quite unhappy due to the high losses in the mansion. But this clown was so entertaining that their mood had improved. They decided to give him an easy death as a reward.
Grandstar stiffened. Why did Su Yu like acting so much? Whatever. Since he was both the director and the actor, so be it.
“Yes.”
“Thank you, Lord.”

With a fearless expression, Su Yu looked at the two immortal kings, wondering who he should kill. All four of them were with their tri-life bodies. Approaching Grandstar without their tri-life bodies would be tantamount to suicide. Thus, this wasn’t surprising.

If Su Yu were to attack Tian Yu, he would not be able to do more than kill one body. He might even fail to achieve that. The other immortal king felt like a fifth-degree Eternal. Someone like that could be killed with three punches, one for each body.
Having made up his mind, Su Yu glared at the immortal king furiously and asked, “What’s your name? I’m killing you!”
“You? Hahahahaha!” The immortal king said, “Sure, I can fulfil your wish. I am—”
“Forget it. You talk too much.”
Su Yu snorted, gnashed his teeth, and charged forth with the same furious expression.
The four Invincibles were stunned.

Was the fake Su Yu really courting death? The immortal king was surprised, but he was also slightly wary. To be safe, he scanned Su Yu and reached out to grab the fake Su Yu. He did not intend to give the fake Su Yu a chance to approach him. One could never be too careful.
He didn’t know what to say anymore. What was this courage? Where did the fake Su Yu get his courage from? Grandstar?
Su Yu continued rushing forth with a determined look. When the palm approached him, he roared, “You dare attack me? This is an attack!”
The immortal king decided to stop wasting time and slap this nobody to death instead.
“You attacked me!”

Su Yu emphasized, making it clear that the immortal king was the one to attack first. Abruptly, his pass character activated, bringing him less than a hundred meters forward. It wasn’t far, but it was enough. The immortal king was within reach. The range of the pass character was short, but it was fast and convenient.
The immortal king sensed the spatial undulations generated by the movement. He was slightly surprised, but he still felt no fear. He formed a fist with his other hand and threw it forward.

It was time for the clown to die. The clown was actually a space specialist. Everyone knew that Su Yu did not have any space characters. Why was this guy using his character if he was so determined to continue the act?
“Heaven Suppressing Fist!”
Just then, Su Yu roared and released all his strength, excluding the yang acupoint.

Screw that. They were already so close to each other! Why was the immortal king still so arrogant? Did the immortal king think that he had never killed Invincibles before? That roar of his attracted numerous gazes.
